$comment: THE ACTION CATALOGUE. Curated, authored like a game's item list — users pick
from it, they never invent verbs, because a free-text verb field breaks the
shared schema the whole ten-year plan depends on (ADR-012).
A VERB IS NEVER RENAMED once shipped, and what a verb MEANS is never changed.
Deprecate by adding a new verb and setting "retired": true on the old one.
What a verb GRANTS is expected to be retuned — which is safe only because
resolved amounts are stored on each event at log time, so a rebalance in 2031
cannot rewrite what someone earned in 2026.
EVERY SKILL MUST BE REACHABLE ALONE, INDOORS, WITHOUT MONEY. That is a hard
product rule, not a nicety: if a skill's only path to progress required leaving
the house or having people, the game would lock that whole tree for anyone
isolated — which is a large part of who this is built for.
`written_by` names a TOOL that writes this action, and means it is NOT tappable
in Hearthsmith's own list. `complete_workout` is written by FitFlexr (ADR-022),
which watched you tick each set off; hand-logging the same workout here would be
a second source of truth for one event, and the honest one is the app that saw it.
The action still counts everywhere it should - it is in the catalogue, it grants
normally, and character.js reads it - it simply has no button.
`needs` names what an action requires beyond the player: "out" (leaving the
house), "people" (someone else), "money". An action with NO `needs` is solo-
reachable, and every skill must have at least one. tests.js enforces it.
Found 2026-08-31: the Community tree had only reached_out / helped_someone /
volunteered — all three requiring other people — so it was unreachable for an
isolated player, and the old test passed it because its tier is literally named
"community". A test that checks the label rather than the property is not a test.
Fixed by adding answered_someone and left_kind_words.
Note that 'hard' pays the MOST. These are the actions that cost the most when
things are bad, and the award table says so out loud.
`stat` names which of the six stats (ECONOMY.md §6, ADR-024) this action feeds,
resolved here at log time so a future retune of this table cannot rewrite what
an event already meant (ADR-012). The rule: tier "upkeep" always feeds spd,
overriding the skill below; every other tier maps by skill — body->str,
kitchen->vit, craft->agi, home->def, community->luk. tests.js enforces this
mapping mechanically so a new action cannot silently violate it.

community.label: Community
community.note: The only tier that later mints core:favor — but only once witnessed at T4. Never at T0.
